Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand. Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more. We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers. We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty. Lead, develop, and facilitate internal and external relationships in support of business objectives. · Internal partners include Sales Insights and Strategy, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finance, Demand Planning, Logistics, Inventory Management, and Customer Service. · External partners include Category Management, Store Operations, Beauty Advisor/Consultant Leadership, Supply Chain/Replenishment, and relevant digital/retail media teams. 7. Partner with Inventory Planning and Logistics to mitigate returns, markdown, and discontinued inventory risk. · Manage timely shutoff of discontinued SKUs based on customer inventory position. · Implement markdowns where there is a financial benefit. · Review new item and bonus pack inventory allocations to ensure the right level of inventory is deployed by store. 9. Lead and develop a team of Customer Business Managers, Associate Customer Business Managers, Analysts, and/or broker support partners. · Provide clear priorities, coaching, performance feedback, development planning, and succession support. · Build team capability in customer management, strategic selling, analytics, cross-functional influence, and executional excellence. 10. Provide channel leadership and support across planning, administration, partnerships, broker support, and collaboration within and across the broader Sales organization. 11. Perform other related duties as required. Supervision: Direct and/or indirect supervision of Customer Business Managers, Analyst, and broker/customer support resource Knowledge and Experience: Experience · 10+ years of direct selling, customer business management, commercial strategy, or related CPG experience required; cosmetics/beauty experience strongly preferred. · Drug channel experience required or strongly preferred; experience managing CVS, Rite Aid, Walgreens, and/or comparable national retail relationships preferred. · Demonstrated experience managing customer P&L, gross sales, trade/MDF investment, forecasting, and cross-functional business planning. · Prior people leadership experience required, including coaching, performance management, and team development. Strategic Thinking · Demonstrated ability to identify short- and long-range sustainable growth opportunities based on an in-depth understanding of company and customer strategies. · Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert POS, syndicated, financial, and marketplace data into compelling sales tools and customer business plans. · Demonstrated ability to take appropriate risks as part of a comprehensive long-range growth plan. Execution and Follow-Through · Ability to drive for results and deliver flawless execution across multiple priorities and stakeholders. · Ability and desire to operate as a hands-on commercial leader while maintaining strategic ownership. · Demonstrated success proactively planning, tracking, and delivering results from strategy through execution. Innovation and Creativity · Experience developing new business-building ideas based on a deep understanding of customer business drivers, shopper needs, category dynamics, and go-to-market strategies. Ability to identify white-space opportunities across innovation, merchandising, retail media, omnichannel, beauty services, and shopper engagement. Problem Solving · Ability to anticipate potential issues and develop proactive solutions to avoid business disruption. · Ability to evaluate multifaceted issues and align stakeholders around the best course of action. Communication and Influence · Executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior customer contacts and Revlon leadership. · Ability to influence cross-functionally and align internal teams around customer priorities, business risks, competitive activity, and execution needs. Systems and Tools · Advanced Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe Acrobat skills required; Access or data visualization experience a plus. · Experience with customer portals, POS/syndicated data platforms, forecasting tools, and financial planning systems preferred. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values: Fight for the Customer Execute Ruthlessly Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly Collaborate Selflessly Practice Calculated Risk-Taking Maximize Joy and Gratitude Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer. Our Ideal Candidate Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives. The Role Hone is looking for a Quality Engineer II to join our Engineering team. This is an early-career role for someone who has a year or two of testing under their belt and is ready to own the quality of their own features. You will report to the Director of QA and work alongside senior quality and software engineers who will help you keep growing. At Hone, there is one Quality Engineer track. You will both test and automate, and you will use AI to do both faster. You will handle small features and bugs with little supervision, deliver scoped work on time, and build the judgment that carries you toward Quality Engineer III and beyond. This is not a manual-only or a script-running role - it is a real engineering career on a clear path. Primary Responsibilities Write and maintain test cases for your own features with little guidance, covering the happy path and the obvious edge cases, and raise risks when you spot them Own testing for the small features and bugs assigned to you, delivering scoped work on time without much hand-holding Write reliable automated tests for your features on your own (end-to-end tests in Playwright and API-level tests) following the team’s conventions Chase down flaky tests and keep your part of the suite stable, asking for help when you need it Run exploratory checks and write clear, reproducible bug reports that anyone on the team can act on Work with AI tools day to day to draft cases, automation, and selectors - and spot and fix output that is wrong or unsafe, following the team’s AI conventions Apply patient-data guardrails consistently: keep test data synthetic and never put real patient data in test cases, bug reports, or any other test artifact Give short, useful code and test reviews, talk through the direction of your own work, and give teammates helpful feedback Qualifications Roughly 1-2 years of experience in software quality, testing, or test automation Working programming or scripting ability in at least one language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C#) Comfortable writing automated tests and maintaining them, ideally with Playwright or comparable UI and API testing frameworks Comfortable with version control (Git), running a test suite, and basic debugging on your own Works with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and reviews their output rather than trusting it blindly Dependable communication: clear bug reports, useful reviews, and the habit of talking through your own work A track record of finishing scoped work on time with little supervision A genuine interest in healthcare and in protecting the patients who rely on our platform We do not expect you to meet every line above. If you are an early-career quality engineer and most of this resonates, please apply. job.description: Back to jobs New ServiceNow Business Analyst United States Apply LightFeather is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead the requirements gathering and process design for our federal agency clients. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between federal business stakeholders and our technical development teams. You will be responsible for translating complex mission requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions, ensuring compliance with federal standards, and maintaining the highest quality of data in our backlog.. This is a Full Time, Remote Position. Location: Fully Remote (EST hours) Job Type: Full-time Salary: $110,000–$130,000 annually, based on experience Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance Responsibilities Lead client workshops and focus groups to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with agency mission goals. Translate high-level business needs into comprehensive user stories, acceptance criteria (AC), and functional specifications within Agile/Scrum frameworks. Conduct gap analysis to identify the delta between current legacy processes and ServiceNow "Out of the Box" (OOTB) functionality. Collaborate directly with the Agile Coach to design, document, and distribute new Agile processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that support all ServiceNow delivery teams. Ensure these processes drive consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the broader program. Review all user stories and requirements for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity. Ensure every story meets the team's "Definition of Ready" before it is approved for sprint planning. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers and junior analysts. Help them understand business context, federal domain constraints, and ServiceNow best practices to foster their professional growth. Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain high standards of quality control across the delivery team. Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and data models to visualize end-to-end service delivery. Advise government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices, steering them away from excessive customization that creates technical debt. Collaborate with System Architects to ensure functional designs are technically feasible. Ensure all solution designs adhere to federal IT standards, including Section 508 compliance (accessibility) and FISMA/NIST security controls. Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, creating test scripts and coordinating testing sessions with government personnel. Create federal-grade deliverables, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), User Guides, and Training Decks. Required Qualifications and Skills: U.S. Citizenship Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level security clearance. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years dedicated to the ServiceNow platform. Proven experience working in the federal contracting space (DoD, DHS, or Civilian agencies). Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and at least one other major workflow (e.g., ITOM, HRSD, SPM, ITAM, Custom Applications). Strong experience with Jira, ServiceNow Agile, or Azure DevOps for backlog management. Proficiency in Visio, LucidChart, or similar tools for process mapping. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - REQUIRED Preferred: ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher). Project Management Professional (PMP) or Agile certifications (CSM, SAFe PO/PM).
